name: Powerful Sneak Attack (Combat)
body:
From the shadows or among friends, your powerful attacks are more deadly.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, Sneak Attack Class Feature

Benefit: When using Power Attack and Sneak Attack for each -1 penalty to melee attack rolls instead of gaining a +2 bonus damage, you can choose to maximize one sneak attack die.

Normal: When using Power Attack, you can choose to suffer a -1 attack penalty to melee attacks and CMB checks to gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls.
